section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 97 | 600 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Side effects | 180 | 600 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
